title: Independently recompute #4602's lever table subset on both invoices with a 40-digit Decimal engine: all values match (no new κ)
body:
Independent recomputation of Matarener's #4602 lever re-pricing (head `0dadb877`). **Every recomputed value matches #4602 to the digits it reports.** No new κ.

`research/pr4602-lever-recompute/verify.py` uses the standard library only and takes about 2 s. Nothing is imported from #4602.

## Method

- **Complex invoice:** rebuilt from main's pinned `CONTROLLER.json` with PR4470's local list.
- **BIT invoice:** read from main's pinned query-thinned `RESULT.json`.
- **Roots:** computed by 40-digit Decimal bisection.

## Results

| quantity | complex | BIT |
|---|---|---|
| baseline root | 0.0030202 | 0.0034642 |
| paid-moment share, idle / local / shears | 59 / 40 / 0.7% | 56 / 43 / 0.8% |
| centre share | 0.5% | — |
| centre free | 0.00765 | — |
| centre shared by two calls | 0.00533 | — |
| query shears free | 0.0099 | 0.0113 |
| two unpaid coordinates per idle family | 0.0282 | 0.0319 |
| free idle stages | > 1/6 | > 1/6 |

**Semantic control:** #4610's changed profile moves the complex baseline off 0.0030202.

## Not recomputed

- the rank-16 children and rank-one pairing rows, which depend on #4602's merge rule;
- the outer rows.
